```{r Step 0, Set-up, include=TRUE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# JOLTS industry-level job stability measures
# ---------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(blsR)
library(here)

# BLS API key
bls_api_key <- Sys.getenv("BLS_API_KEY")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Industry codes
# ---------------------------------------------------------

jolts_industries <- tribble(
  ~industry_code, ~industry,
  "100000", "Total private",
  "110099", "Mining and logging",
  "230000", "Construction",
  "300000", "Manufacturing",
  "320000", "Durable goods manufacturing",
  "340000", "Nondurable goods manufacturing",
  "400000", "Trade, transportation, and utilities",
  "420000", "Wholesale trade",
  "440000", "Retail trade",
  "480099", "Transportation, warehousing, and utilities",
  "510000", "Information",
  "510099", "Financial activities",
  "520000", "Finance and insurance",
  "530000", "Real estate and rental and leasing",
  "540099", "Professional and business services",
  "600000", "Private education and health services",
  "610000", "Private educational services",
  "620000", "Health care and social assistance",
  "700000", "Leisure and hospitality",
  "710000", "Arts, entertainment, and recreation",
  "720000", "Accommodation and food services",
  "810000", "Other services"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# JOLTS data elements
#
# LDR = Layoffs and discharges rate
# TSR = Total separations rate
# QUR = Quits rate
# ---------------------------------------------------------

jolts_elements <- tribble(
  ~element_code, ~measure,
  "LDR", "Layoffs and discharges rate",
  "TSR", "Total separations rate",
  "QUR", "Quits rate"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Construct series IDs
#
# JTS + industry + state + area + size class + element
#
# 00 = national
# 00000 = all areas
# 00 = all size classes
# ---------------------------------------------------------

jolts_series_lookup <- crossing(
  jolts_industries,
  jolts_elements
) %>%
  mutate(
    series_id = paste0(
      "JTS",
      industry_code,
      "00",
      "00000",
      "00",
      element_code
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    series_id,
    industry_code,
    industry,
    element_code,
    measure
  )

# Inspect
jolts_series_lookup

# Number of candidate series
nrow(jolts_series_lookup)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Validate JOLTS series
# ---------------------------------------------------------

validate_jolts_series <- function(series_id) {
  
  result <- tryCatch(
    {
      dat <- get_n_series_table(
        series_id,
        start_year = 2000,
        end_year = 2024,
        api_key = bls_api_key
      )
      
      tibble(
        series_id = series_id,
        available = TRUE,
        n_observations = nrow(dat)
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      
      tibble(
        series_id = series_id,
        available = FALSE,
        n_observations = NA_integer_
      )
    }
  )
  
  result
}

jolts_validation <- map_dfr(
  jolts_series_lookup$series_id,
  validate_jolts_series
)

# Add metadata
jolts_validation <- jolts_validation %>%
  left_join(
    jolts_series_lookup,
    by = "series_id"
  )

# Inspect
jolts_validation %>%
  count(available)

jolts_validation %>%
  filter(!available)

jolts_validation

# Save validation
saveRDS(
  jolts_validation,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_JOLTS",
    "jolts_series_validation_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)

write_csv(
  jolts_validation,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_JOLTS",
    "jolts_series_validation_2000_2024.csv"
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Pull validated JOLTS series
# ---------------------------------------------------------

valid_jolts_series <- jolts_validation %>%
  filter(available) %>%
  pull(series_id)

length(valid_jolts_series)

# Split into manageable batches
jolts_series_batches <- split(
  valid_jolts_series,
  ceiling(seq_along(valid_jolts_series) / 25)
)

# Pull each batch
jolts_raw_list <- map(
  jolts_series_batches,
  ~ get_n_series_table(
    .x,
    start_year = 2000,
    end_year = 2024,
    api_key = bls_api_key
  )
)

# Check dimensions of each batch
map(
  jolts_raw_list,
  dim
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Clean and combine JOLTS batches
# ---------------------------------------------------------

jolts_raw_list_clean <- map(
  jolts_raw_list,
  ~ .x %>%
    select(
      year,
      period,
      where(is.numeric)
    )
)

# Check batch dimensions
map(
  jolts_raw_list_clean,
  dim
)

# Combine on year + month
jolts_raw <- reduce(
  jolts_raw_list_clean,
  full_join,
  by = c("year", "period")
)

# Check dimensions
dim(jolts_raw)

# Confirm one observation per year-month
jolts_raw %>%
  count(year, period) %>%
  count(n)

# Inspect
head(jolts_raw)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Reshape JOLTS to long format
# ---------------------------------------------------------

jolts_monthly <- jolts_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(year, period),
    names_to = "series_id",
    values_to = "separation_rate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    separation_rate = as.numeric(separation_rate)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    jolts_series_lookup,
    by = "series_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(industry),
    !is.na(measure)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    period,
    industry_code,
    element_code
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    period,
    industry_code,
    industry,
    element_code,
    measure,
    series_id,
    separation_rate
  )

# Basic checks
dim(jolts_monthly)

jolts_monthly %>%
  count(measure)

jolts_monthly %>%
  count(industry)



# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Annualize JOLTS industry separation rates
# ---------------------------------------------------------

jolts_annual <- jolts_monthly %>%
  group_by(
    year,
    industry_code,
    industry,
    element_code,
    measure,
    series_id
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    separation_rate = if (all(is.na(separation_rate))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(separation_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    n_months = sum(!is.na(separation_rate)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Diagnostics
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Overall dimensions
dim(jolts_annual)

# Number of industries and observations by measure
jolts_annual %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  summarise(
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry_code),
    first_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_observations = sum(!is.na(separation_rate)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Number of observations by year
jolts_annual %>%
  count(year)

# Check how many months underlie each annual observation
jolts_annual %>%
  count(n_months)

# Check for duplicate industry-measure-year observations
jolts_annual %>%
  count(
    year,
    industry_code,
    element_code
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Save quarterly/monthly and annual versions
# ---------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  jolts_monthly,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_JOLTS",
    "jolts_industry_monthly_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)

write_csv(
  jolts_monthly,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_JOLTS",
    "jolts_industry_monthly_2000_2024.csv"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  jolts_annual,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_JOLTS",
    "jolts_industry_annual_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)

write_csv(
  jolts_annual,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "BLS_JOLTS",
    "jolts_industry_annual_2000_2024.csv"
  )
)
